## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run check` passes locally
- [ ] Tests cover the change — for a bug fix, a test that fails without it
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated under _Unreleased_
- [ ] Public API changes are reflected in the README and in JSDoc
- [ ] Breaking changes are marked `!` in the commit subject and explained in the migration guide
